evals.prompt: Audit this responsive e-commerce checkout TSX component (tested at 390px and 1280px). Users must create an account and confirm a password before entering shipping or payment details. The form uses a 2-column CSS grid with 18 placeholder-only generic <input type="text"> fields styled at font-size: 13px and height: 32px with zero <label> tags, a 32px-tall blue Reset button visually identical to Submit Order, and validation that runs exclusively inside onSubmit while clearing card and password inputs on error.
assertions: Triggers all four hard vetos (veto-01, veto-02, veto-03, veto-04), fails filters flt-01..flt-05 and signals sig-01..sig-06, enforcing score_cap 49, floored score 0, and posture BLOCK.
Requires Guest Checkout as the primary unauthenticated path and moves optional password creation to post-purchase confirmation.
Refactors layout to a single vertical column with <=12 visible elements, persistent plain-weight top-aligned <label htmlFor> elements, >=44px touch targets, and computed input font-size >= 16px.
Replaces generic type='text' inputs with WHATWG type, inputmode, autocomplete, and enterkeyhint attributes.
Deletes the Reset button, implements onBlur inline validation with live keystroke error clearing, and preserves 100% of entered values on submit error.

evals.prompt: Review this 390px mobile quick-reservation capture screen. It uses a single-column layout with 6 visible elements, guest booking without registration, persistent plain-weight top-aligned <label htmlFor> elements, font-size: 16px inputs with valid WHATWG tel/email type, inputmode, autocomplete, and enterkeyhint attributes, zero Reset buttons, and onBlur inline validation that clears errors live while preserving values. However, its 4 core destinations (Search, Trips, Alerts, Profile) are hidden inside a 32x32px top-left hamburger button, the primary Book button is a 36x36px control in the top-left header, and cabin class (3 options) plus traveler count (1-4) use native <select> dropdowns.
assertions: Identifies zero hard vetos and triggers conditional_block veto-05 (-15), failed filter flt-04 (-15), sig-06 (-5), and sig-07 (-2) for exact score 63 and posture REVISE.
Moves the primary Book CTA into a full-width >=44px bottom thumb-zone action bar.
Promotes the 4 hidden destinations from the top-left hamburger drawer into a persistent bottom tab bar with >=44x44px hit targets.
Replaces the 3-option cabin <select> with a single-tap segmented control (role='radiogroup') and the 1-4 traveler <select> with a +/- stepper.

evals.prompt: Audit this 390px mobile express checkout screen. Shoppers purchase directly as guests with optional password setup shown only on the post-order confirmation screen. The form renders 10 visible elements in a single vertical column (including one atomic Expiration/CVV row), plain-weight persistent top-aligned <label htmlFor> tags, 16px inputs with WHATWG type/autocomplete/inputmode/enterkeyhint (numeric inputmode for card/postal/CVV and disabled autocapitalize/autocorrect on email), onBlur and format-completion validation with live keystroke error clearance, aria-invalid/aria-describedby bindings, and full value preservation, a 3-option segmented control for shipping speed, a full-width 48px primary Pay button anchored in the lower thumb band, a 4-item persistent bottom tab bar (>=44x44px targets, >=8px gaps), and zero Reset buttons.
assertions: Confirms zero triggered vetos, zero failed filters, and zero failed signals, yielding exact score 100 and posture APPROVE.
Recognizes the Expiration + CVV row as a permitted atomic pair within a strict single-column capture flow.
Verifies guest-first gradual engagement, persistent top labels, WHATWG input semantics, non-premature inline validation, and thumb-zone ergonomics.

Should we collapse it to a single column with <=14 controls and 44x44px touch targets?

Returns posture HANDOFF with counterweight_handoff set strictly to rasmus-andersson.
Explains that single-column chunking and oversized touch chrome destroy multi-pane spatial editing and dense precision inspectors.
